_comment: Model pack locations for the QwenZImageNative backend. Read automatically unless a path is given with --config / QZI_CONFIG. Top-level keys apply to every platform; a windows/linux/osx object overrides them there. Values may start with ~. Unknown keys are an error, keys starting with _ are comments. Model packs are data on disk: these example paths are the development machine's existing pack directories and can be renamed freely.
_note: The Windows paths below are absolute so this file works as-is on the machine that owns the weights. The 'h3-models' segment is just that machine's existing on-disk data directory name (inherited from the upstream project); it is NOT a product, symbol or artifact name - no QwenZImageNative artifact uses it. Rename it freely, or edit these values / set QZI_QWEN21_DIR and QZI_ZIMAGE_DIR on any other host.
